_about: PF2e conditions (Player Core) for the GM combat tracker: what each one does to a creature's numbers. Read by avtools/combat.py. Stats: ac, fort, ref, will, perception, melee and ranged (attack rolls), spell_dc, spell_attack, skills; 'all' means every check and DC, 'saves' the three saves. A status penalty and a circumstance penalty stack with each other, but only the worst of each type applies. amount 'value' is the condition's value.

conditions.name: Off-Guard
conditions.summary: -2 circumstance to AC.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.summary: Status penalty to all checks and DCs. Drops by 1 at the end of each of its turns.

conditions.name: Sickened
conditions.summary: Status penalty to all checks and DCs. Can't willingly ingest anything. Retch (1 action, Fort save) to reduce it.

conditions.name: Clumsy
conditions.summary: Status penalty to Dex-based checks and DCs: AC, Reflex, ranged and finesse attacks, Acrobatics, Stealth, Thievery.

conditions.name: Enfeebled
conditions.summary: Status penalty to Str-based rolls and DCs: Str melee attacks, Str damage, Athletics.

conditions.name: Drained
conditions.summary: Status penalty to Con-based checks (Fortitude). Loses HP equal to level x value, and max HP drops by the same.

conditions.name: Stupefied
conditions.summary: Status penalty to Int-, Wis- and Cha-based checks and DCs: Will, Perception, spell attacks and DCs. Casting a spell needs a DC 5 + value flat check.

conditions.name: Fatigued
conditions.summary: -1 status to AC and saves.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.summary: Off-guard, -2 circumstance to attack rolls. Only Crawl and Stand as move actions. +1 circumstance AC vs ranged if it Takes Cover.

conditions.name: Grabbed
conditions.summary: Off-guard and immobilized. Manipulate actions need a DC 5 flat check.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.summary: Off-guard and immobilized. No attack or manipulate actions except to Escape or Force Open.

conditions.name: Immobilized
conditions.summary: Can't use move actions.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.summary: Off-guard. Can't act except Recall Knowledge and purely mental actions.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.summary: Can't act. -4 status to AC, Perception and Reflex; blinded, off-guard and prone.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.summary: Can't see: all terrain is difficult, everything is hidden to it. -4 status to Perception if vision is its only precise sense.

conditions.name: Dazzled
conditions.summary: If vision is its only precise sense, everything is concealed to it (DC 5 flat check to target).

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.summary: Can't hear. -2 status to Perception (initiative too). Auditory actions need a DC 5 flat check.

conditions.name: Fascinated
conditions.summary: -2 status to Perception and skill checks. No concentrate actions unrelated to the subject. Ends if anyone hostile acts against it or its allies.

conditions.name: Confused
conditions.summary: Off-guard, treats no one as an ally, Strikes a random creature. DC 11 flat check to end it after taking damage.

conditions.name: Slowed
conditions.summary: Regains that many fewer actions at the start of its turn.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.summary: Can't act. Loses that many actions as it regains them, then the condition ends.

conditions.name: Quickened
conditions.summary: Gains 1 extra action at the start of its turn (limited to what the effect allows).

conditions.name: Fleeing
conditions.summary: Must spend its actions getting away from the source.

conditions.name: Controlled
conditions.summary: Its controller decides how it acts.

conditions.name: Doomed
conditions.summary: Dies at dying 4 minus this value.

conditions.name: Hidden
conditions.summary: Its space is known but not its exact position: off-guard to it, DC 11 flat check to target it.

conditions.name: Concealed
conditions.summary: DC 5 flat check to target it.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.summary: Undetected to everyone; Seek to make it hidden.

conditions.name: Persistent damage
conditions.summary: Takes the damage at the end of each of its turns, then a DC 15 flat check ends it (assisted recovery: DC 10).
